hebrewText: בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ חֲ֠לָלִים נָתְנ֨וּ מִשְׁכָּ֥ב לָ/הּ֙ בְּ/כָל הֲמוֹנָ֔/הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖י/ו קִבְרֹתֶ֑/הָ כֻּלָּ֣/ם עֲרֵלִ֣ים חַלְלֵי חֶ֡רֶב כִּֽי נִתַּ֨ן חִתִּיתָ֜/ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֗ים וַ/יִּשְׂא֤וּ כְלִמָּתָ/ם֙ אֶת י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ חֲלָלִ֖ים נִתָּֽן

tokens.bdb: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
tokens.kjv: among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).

tokens.bdb: pierced (especially to death); figuratively, polluted
tokens.kjv: kill, profane, slain (man), [idiom] slew, (deadly) wounded.

tokens.bdb: a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse
tokens.kjv: bed(-chamber), couch, lieth (lying) with.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a noise, tumult, crowd; also disquietude, wealth
tokens.kjv: abundance, company, many, multitude, multiply, noise, riches, rumbling, sounding, store, tumult.

tokens.bdb: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
tokens.kjv: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

tokens.bdb: a sepulchre
tokens.kjv: burying place, grave, sepulchre.

tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: uncircumcised (i.e. still having the prepuce uncurtailed)
tokens.kjv: uncircumcised (person).

tokens.bdb: pierced (especially to death); figuratively, polluted
tokens.kjv: kill, profane, slain (man), [idiom] slew, (deadly) wounded.

tokens.bdb: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
tokens.kjv: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
